service.method: SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE , DEPT.COMPANY_CODE , DEPT.MANAGER_ID , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO FROM SDEPT DEPT INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = DEPT.MANAGER_ID WHERE DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = ${DEPT} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT BALN.HOUSE_CODE , BALN.COMPANY_CODE , BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SBALN BALN INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND BALN.CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(BALN.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
